tokens.v: Plant the outsole into loose ash mid-stride, lugs biting a shallow crater and throwing a fan of grey grit up behind the heel, grains still airborne, a faint smear on the drifting ash alone while the shoe holds razor sharp; disregard the slim display stand that follows. 50mm at f/5.6 from ash level, the smoldering horizon glow banding low through the frame, the dark sky taking the upper third. A ridge of ash blurs across the extreme foreground and runs out both side edges. VOSS ROWE sits heat-welded in matte TPU across the heel counter, a millimetre proud of the ripstop, ash settling along its lower edge.
